result.scope: successor-probe lesion/rescue sandbox contract; not physical execution of every historical service binary

interpretation: A legacy process/service boundary may disappear only if its source-resolved function remains mapped to a measurable successor component whose function can be selectively lesioned and restored without unrelated probe loss.
feedback: Use source-backed successor lesion/rescue as the conservation criterion for fused/emergently distributed legacy functions. Extend the same method to persistent state/database functions before declaring whole-Frank conservation.
